items.title: File Widerspruch against street-sale ban
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispiel-Spreebogen von Berlin, Rathausstraße 11, 10589 Berlin. Wird er mit der Post versandt, gilt er am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben.
items.computation: Letter (Bescheid) is dated Fri 20.11.2026; no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so the posting day = document date 20.11.2026. Deemed delivery = 4th day after posting (letter's own clause, matching § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG/Berlin general-authority rule): 20.11 +4 days -> 21.11 (Sat, day1), 22.11 (Sun, day2), 23.11 (Mon, day3), 24.11 (Tue, day4) = delivery day. This is a general authority (Ordnungsamt), not a tax office, so the 4th-day rule is NOT shifted for weekends/holidays - but 24.11.2026 is itself a Tuesday working day, so delivery stands at 24.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period runs from this delivery day under § 70 VwGO / § 31 Abs. 1 VwVfG with §§ 187, 188 BGB counting: the delivery day itself is not counted as day 1 of the period, and a 'one month after notification' period ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24 December is a normal working day in Germany (not a statutory holiday; 24 and 31 Dec are expressly working days under the stated rules), so no further shift under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG/§193 BGB is needed. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.
